plan.control_rule: First count/8 indices sorted by SHA256(class1-controls-v2/index), with that same score-independent order; both signs eligible.
plan.cost_rule: per-parameter scoring CPU plus equal share of cold residue-table CPU, and isolated process-tree search CPU including bank, points, replay and reconciliation; preparation cost reported separately.
plan.failure_semantics: Censored/failed/generic-gate misses remain UNKNOWN and retain all logs/clouds; no automatic repeat of the same failed batch.
plan.full_cloud_reconciliation: Every batch, including below23, with two finite certificate implementations.
plan.score_definition: sum round(1e12*(2-a_p)*log(p)/(p+1-a_p)) over smooth reductions of coefficientwise p-minimized charts; skipped local singular reductions are recorded, not rank exclusions.
plan.subsequent_window_rule: contiguous address windows, double size up to 262144; freeze each before scoring

old_campaign_boundary: Sign-confounded v1 commissioning controls kept separate; all cost and point evidence retained.
claim_boundary: Launched prospective search with frozen scoring, controls and certified V3. No high-rank result or triage-efficiency claim yet.
